article.title: Why Data Pipelines Need Idempotent Writes

paragraphs.en:
Retries are normal in production data systems. A network call can time out, a worker can crash, or a database can briefly become unavailable. The dangerous part is not the retry itself. The danger appears when repeating the same write creates a second business event.

Imagine a pipeline that receives an order and writes one row to a billing table. The database successfully saves the row, but the worker loses the response before it records success. The job retries. If the second attempt blindly inserts another row, the customer may be charged twice even though there was only one order.

An idempotent write is designed so that repeating the same logical operation produces the same final effect as performing it once. One common technique is an idempotency key: a stable identifier for the business operation, such as an order ID plus an operation type. The receiving system stores the key and rejects or safely returns the previous result when the same operation arrives again.

Databases offer other patterns. An upsert can update an existing record instead of creating a duplicate. A unique constraint can prevent two rows with the same business key. A merge operation can make batch loads repeatable. The right design depends on whether the intended action is insert, update, replacement, or accumulation.

Accumulation is especially tricky. If a job says ‘add 100 points,’ running it twice adds 200. A safer design may record a unique earning event and calculate the balance from deduplicated events, or write the desired final state when that is appropriate.

Idempotency does not eliminate every distributed-systems problem. Teams still need transaction boundaries, ordering rules, monitoring, and reconciliation. But it changes retry behavior from something frightening into something operationally manageable.

The principle also improves backfills and recovery. Engineers can rerun a failed partition or replay messages without manually deleting uncertain results first. That reduces operational risk and makes incident response faster.

Idempotency must also be defined at the correct business level. Two HTTP requests may be technically different while representing the same customer order. Conversely, two legitimate purchases may have similar payloads but must not be deduplicated. A reliable key therefore represents the logical business action, not merely the transport message.

Monitoring remains important because deduplication itself can fail. Teams should track duplicate-key events, retry volume, reconciliation differences, and unusual replay rates. These signals help distinguish expected recovery behavior from a broken producer that repeatedly sends the same event.

When designing a pipeline, ask: ‘If this exact operation runs twice, what happens?’ If the answer is duplicate rows, duplicate payments, or duplicate notifications, the write path needs a deliberate replay strategy. Reliable systems assume retries will happen and make repeated execution safe by design.
paragraphs.zh:
Production pipeline 發生 retry 很正常；真正危險的是同一個 logical write 重跑後產生第二次 business event。例如訂單其實已成功寫入，但 worker 在收到成功回覆前中斷，retry 若再次 insert，就可能造成重複扣款。

Idempotent write 的目標是讓同一 logical operation 執行多次，最終效果仍等同執行一次。常見方法包括 idempotency key、upsert、unique constraint、merge 與以唯一事件為基礎的累計。尤其「加 100 點」這種 accumulation 若直接重跑會變成加 200 點，需要更謹慎的事件設計。

Idempotency 並不能取代 transaction、ordering、monitoring、reconciliation，但能讓 retry、backfill、message replay 更安全。Key 必須對應真正的 business action，而不是只看 HTTP message。設計 pipeline 時應固定問一句：同一操作跑兩次會發生什麼？
paragraphs.ja:
本番データパイプラインではretryは普通に発生します。危険なのはretryそのものではなく、同じ論理的なwriteを再実行したときに二つ目のbusiness eventが作られることです。注文の書き込み自体は成功したのに、workerが成功応答を受け取る前に停止すると、単純な再insertで二重請求が起こり得ます。

Idempotent writeは、同じ論理操作を複数回実行しても最終結果が一回実行時と同じになるよう設計します。idempotency key、upsert、unique constraint、mergeなどが代表例です。「100ポイント加算」のような累積処理は二回実行すると200になるため、unique eventを記録する設計などが必要です。

Idempotencyだけでtransactionやordering、monitoring、reconciliationが不要になるわけではありません。ただしretry、backfill、message replayを安全にしやすくなります。設計時には「この操作が二回走ったら何が起きるか」を必ず確認します。
